list.title: computer software engineer (junior level)
list.description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a Senior Computer Software Engineer to lead technical work on the company's database and storage infrastructure platforms in Singapore. You will research, design, and develop large-scale, specialised software systems that power our database and storage services, and partner with hardware and platform engineers to deliver highly available, cost-efficient infrastructure operating at scale across multiple data centres.
Responsibilities
- Responsible for the design, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimisation of large-scale database and storage    systems, ensuring high availability, scalability, and reliability.
- Research, design, and develop computer and network software, and specialised utility programs, for distributed database and storage platforms operating    at PB-scale and across multiple data centres (including relational and    analytics databases, NoSQL systems, and Hadoop-based big-data platforms).
- Update software, enhance existing software capabilities, and develop and    direct software testing and validation procedures, including performance,    failover, chaos, and data-integrity testing for database and storage services.
- Work closely with computer hardware engineers and data-centre operations teams to integrate hardware and software systems, and develop detailed specifications and performance requirements for storage media, server SKUs, and network topology.
- Build tools, automation, visualizations, and monitors to facilitate the operation and optimization of the global infrastructure.
- Establish operational standards, runbooks, SLO/SLI frameworks, and on-call practices for the database and storage platform team.
- Mentor junior engineers, conduct design and code reviews, and lead knowledge transfer and technical training.
list.requirement:
Requirements
- Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Programming & Systems Analysis, Science (Computer Studies), or Software Engineering.
- 3+ years of production experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed database and/or storage systems.
- Deep proficiency in at least one systems language (Java, Go, C++, or Rust) and strong grasp of distributed-systems fundamentals (CAP, consensus, replication, fault tolerance).
- Experience integrating hardware and software systems and defining hardware performance requirements in partnership with infrastructure or hardware engineering teams.
- Ability to communicate in Mandarin and English, in order to support coordination and collaboration with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders, teams, and business partners across regional markets.
- Hands-on production experience operating one or more of: MySQL，Redis， HDFS, Elasticsearch, HBase, or comparable distributed systems is preferred.

list.title: Government Relation Manager, Indonesia
list.description:
1. Establish and maintain relationship with important government agencies / industry associations / foreign embassies / third parties. Leveraging governmental relationship to assist in permits and license application process. 
2. Arrange high-level meetings and attend public events, identify potential risks / business opportunities and advocate for the interest of Xiaomi. 
3. Tackle market access constraints, product compliance and various ad hoc corporate issues that might arise from government agencies. 
4. Engage directly with policymakers, government agencies to shape policy and political dialogue which impact Xiaomi business objective. Manage policy projects on opportunities affecting Xiaomi products area (including, user privacy, content, competition and cross industry relations). 
5. Design, implement and execute country-specific government affairs programs which tied up with government bodies key programs and interests. 
6. Collaborate cross-functionally with local business units (e.g. Products, Marketing, Public Relation, Legal) and advise on policy and political implications of product development and market operations. 
7. Be part of local crisis management team to liaison with government agencies during crisis. Lead incident response relating to government requirement, negotiate with government authorities to advocate for business priorities, and appropriately escalate when needed to drive solution.
list.requirement:
1. Bachelor's degree from relevant field (e.g. Politics, International Relations, Legal, Politics, etc) .
2. 3 - 5 years’ experience in government, and/or in government affairs functions with a renowned multinational corporation, consulting firm, law firm, industrial association, etc.
3. Fluent interpersonal, verbal, and written skills in Bahasa and English.
4. Good network of key government body, regulatory agencies, industry organization and other stakeholders in Indonesia.
5. Proven experience of working directly with Indonesia policymakers and regulators.
6. Working knowledge of smartphone, consumer electronics and/or automotive industry and regulatory landscape is highly preferred.
7. Strategic thinker with leadership, outreach, analytical and negotiation skills.
8. Ability to manage multiple projects and to work collaboratively across different teams (internal and external) in a cross-cultural environment.
9. Ability to grasp complex technical and policy issues and communicate key messages with internal and external stakeholders. Willing to working on difficult issues and capability in solving problems creatively.
